about: The host bridge's actions for what only macOS does (M2m), and the phone's text into a Mac terminal (I5, IGL: the Swift engine's own Deck.typePhoneWords; the app asks the core the desk's state on the same connection, where the Swift engine looks at its own sessions, which no case here shows: the held one is the core saying it's asking; phone-text.json has the whole table): each request as the Go core sends it (desktop/hostbridge.go, without its token) and the Mac app's answer (Sources/AgentDeck/HostBridge.swift), on the stand-ins both tests use. desktop/hostbridge_test.go checks the core asks exactly this and reads the answer; HostBridgeTests.swift checks the app answers exactly this.
